        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

            current_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

            if self.previous_spy_close is not None and self.previous_spy_sma is not None:
                spy_crosses_below_sma = (
                    self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma and
                    spy_bar.Close < current_spy_sma
                )

                if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crosses_below_sma:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            if self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > self.rsi_sell_threshold:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            current_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

            if (
                self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and
                self.previous_spy_close is not None and
                self.previous_spy_sma is not None and
                self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma and
                spy_bar.Close > current_spy_sma
            ):
                quantity = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_bar.Close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_closes.IsReady:
            red_for_three_days = (
                self.aapl_closes[0] < self.aapl_closes[1] and
                self.aapl_closes[1] < self.aapl_closes[2] and
                self.aapl_closes[2] < self.aapl_closes[3]
            )

            if red_for_three_days and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                quantity = int(20_000 / aapl_bar.Close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

        self.aapl_closes.Add(aapl_bar.Close)

        if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

from AlgorithmImports import *


class IndependentSlotsStrategy(QCAlgorithm):
    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = {
            ticker: self.add_equity(ticker, Resolution.DAILY).symbol
            for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
        }

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14)

        self.spy_previous_close = None
        self.spy_previous_sma = None
        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        self.rsi_threshold = 70

    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
        all_bars_present = all(
            data.bars.contains_key(symbol) and data.bars[symbol] is not None
            for symbol in self.symbols.values()
        )

        spy_bar = data.bars[self.spy] if data.bars.contains_key(self.spy) else None
        aapl_bar = data.bars[self.aapl] if data.bars.contains_key(self.aapl) else None

        previous_spy_close = self.spy_previous_close
        previous_spy_sma = self.spy_previous_sma
        previous_aapl_close = self.aapl_previous_close

        if spy_bar is not None:
            self.spy_sma.update(self.time, spy_bar.close)

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            self.aapl_rsi.update(self.time, aapl_bar.close)

            if previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_bar.close < previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        if (
            all_bars_present
            and self.spy_sma.is_ready
            and self.aapl_rsi.is_ready
            and previous_spy_close is not None
            and previous_spy_sma is not None
        ):
            spy_close = spy_bar.close
            aapl_close = aapl_bar.close

            # Sells are evaluated before buys.
            if (
                self.strategy_a_shares > 0
                and previous_spy_close >= previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close < self.spy_sma.current.value
            ):
                self.market_order(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0

            if (
                self.strategy_b_shares > 0
                and self.aapl_rsi.current.value > self.rsi_threshold
            ):
                self.market_order(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                self.strategy_b_shares = 0

            if (
                self.strategy_a_shares == 0
                and previous_spy_close <= previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close > self.spy_sma.current.value
            ):
                target_value = self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value * 0.40
                quantity = int(target_value / spy_close)

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.market_order(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

            if (
                self.strategy_b_shares == 0
                and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
                and self.portfolio.cash >= 20_000
            ):
                quantity = int(20_000 / aapl_close)

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.market_order(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

        if spy_bar is not None:
            self.spy_previous_close = spy_bar.close
            self.spy_previous_sma = self.spy_sma.current.value

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_bar.close
